A LITTLE SURPRISE

Made for
one person.

And that person is you.

29 • 09 • 2007

TODAY IS DIFFERENT

Happy Birthday, Diyaa.

Today isn't just another date on the calendar. It's the day someone incredibly special came into this world.

01 / SOMETHING TO SAY

I don't always say everything I'm feeling.

Sometimes I fail to express it.

Sometimes anger gets in the way.

And sometimes...

words simply stop.
♡

Kintu kotha bondho holeo, tomar importance kokhono bondho hoy na.

02 / SOME FEELINGS

Some feelings don't know how to become words.

There are things I've wanted to say for a long time.

But every time I try, the words feel smaller than what I actually mean.

You've never been ordinary to me.
♡

Kichu kotha bola hoy na, kintu tar mane ei na je segulo feel kora hoy na.

02 / THINGS I REGRET

Things I wish
I had done differently.

01

I wish I had listened more.

02

I wish I had chosen patience over anger.

03

I wish some words had never been said.

And for those moments...

I'm genuinely sorry.

Rager muhurte bola kichu kotha pore nijer kachei kharap lage.
03 / WHERE YOU STAND

You have a place
that isn't ordinary.

Maybe I don't always show it perfectly. Maybe I don't always know how to say it. But your place in my life matters.

Important. Meaningful. Priority.

Tumi amar priority list-er ekta naam na. Tumi oi list-er ekta important reason.

04 / HER

Beautiful isn't the only word.

The smile.
The person.

You are simply... you.

05 / EVEN IN SILENCE

Sometimes we talk for hours.

Sometimes we don't talk at all.

Sometimes we're perfectly fine.

Sometimes we're not.

But somehow... Kotha bondho hoye geleo, mon theke importance-ta bondho hoye jay na.
06 / IF SOMEDAY YOU WONDER

Did I ever really matter?

I hope you remember this little website.
♡

Kichu manushke mone rakhar jonno kono special reason lage na. Tara nijer ojantei moner ekta jayga hoye jay.

06 / A LETTER FOR YOU

You have a letter.

Some things are easier to write than to say.

Dear Diyaa,

I don't know if I've ever explained this properly.

You've become someone whose presence matters to me more than I sometimes know how to express.

We've had beautiful moments. We've had difficult ones too.

We've misunderstood each other, argued, gone quiet... but somehow, you've remained important.

Maybe that's what makes this real.

Shob kichur poreo, tomake amar life-e thakte dekhar icchata kokhono kome nai.

— From someone who cares ♡

THERE IS ONE LAST THING...

Diyaa,

I don't want to promise you a perfect story.

I want to build a real one.

So here's the question...

Will you choose me?

Shob bhalo din-er sathe, kharap din-gulo teo?

Take your time. I'll still be here. ♡

AND JUST LIKE THAT...

Happy Birthday,
Diyaa. ♡

19 looks beautiful on you.

Aaj tomar birthday, tai aajker shobcheye boro wish-ta tomar jonno.

Jibon tomake onek dure niye jak, onek shukhi koruk.

Ar jodi amar jonno ekta chotto jayga thake, sheta ami khub jotno kore rakhte chai.
Tomar hashi jeno kokhono hariye na jay. ♡
